content: आक्षेपः .²1 Throwing off, tossing, pulling off, snatching away; अंशुकाक्षेपविलज्जितानाम् <ls>Ku. 1. 14</ls>; withdrawing; वदनमपहरन्तीं तत्कृताक्षेपमीशः <ls>Ku. 7. 95</ls>; movement, shaking; <ls>K. 13</ls>. .²2 Reviling, censure, blame, abuse, reproach, defiant censure; इति ब्रह्मोदिताक्षेपैः स्थानादिन्द्रः प्रचालितः <ls>Bhāg. 12. 6. 22</ls>. ˚प्रचण्डतया <ls>U. 5. 28</ls>; बिरुद्धमाक्षेपवचस्तितिक्षितम् <ls>Ki. 14. 25</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 69</ls>. .²3 Drawing together, attraction, diverting; कथारसस्याक्षेपसामर्थ्यम् <ls>K. 346</ls>, <ls n="K.">348</ls> power to interest .²4 Distraction, allurement; विषयाक्षेपपर्यस्तबुद्धेः <ls>Bh. 3. 47</ls>, <ls n="Bh. 3.">23</ls>. .²5 Throwing away, giving up. .²6 Applying, laying on, putting in or into (as a colour); गोरोचनाक्षेपनितान्तगौरैः <ls>Ku. 7. 17</ls>. .²7 Hinting at, reference to, taking to oneself or assuming as the meaning of another word; स्वसिद्धये पराक्षेपः <ls>K. P. 2</ls>. .²8 An inference. .²9 A deposit. .²10 An objection or doubt. .²11 Convulsion, palpitation. .²12 Sustaining, as a sound. .²13 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A figure of speech (<ab>cf.</ab> Greek paralipsis) in which something really intended to be said is apparently suppressed or denied to convey a particular meaning; आक्षेपः स्वयमुक्तस्य प्रतिषेधो विचारणात् . चन्द्रसंदर्शयात्मानमथवास्ति प्रियामुखम् .. <ls>Kuval.</ls> For fuller definitions and explanations see <ls>K. P. 10</ls>, <ls>S. D. 714</ls> and {%Akṣepaprakaraṇa%} in <ls>R. G.</ls> .²14 Reach (of an arrow); सोऽयं प्राप्तस्तवाक्षेपम् <ls>Mb. 7. 102. 6</ls>.
